say:2:1310235001:0.text: The festival is so much fun! Whether it's building snowmen, snowball fights, or ice skating, everything's a blast. Even the Snowman Chase, despite that dodo's mistake, was fun!
say:2:1310235001:0.source_cn: 祭典太有趣了！不管是堆雪人打雪仗还是滑冰都很好玩，就算...

say:3:1310235002:0.text: Right? I've always thought the Snowspire Festival is the best holiday in the whole duchy!
say:3:1310235002:0.source_cn: 对吧？我一直觉得冬日祭典是整个公国最好玩的节日！

say:4:1310235003:0.text: I'm so glad you guys had a good time!
say:4:1310235003:0.source_cn: 你们也喜欢，真是太好了！

say:5:1310235004:0.text: But you still haven't experienced the most exciting and popular activity of the festival!
say:5:1310235004:0.source_cn: 不过，祭典里最有趣、最刺激、最受欢迎的项目你们还没体验到呢！

say:6:1310235005:0.text: What? There's still something we haven't tried? No way!
say:6:1310235005:0.source_cn: 什么什么？还有我们没玩到的？公主殿下，你说的是什么项目？

say:7:1310235006:0.text: It'd be boring if I just spilled the beans! Come on, follow me! Let's go check out the ads on the <style="highlight">notice board</style>. Let's see if you can guess what the activity is!
say:7:1310235006:0.source_cn: 直接说出来多没意思！跟我来，我带你们去<style=h...

say:8:1310235007:0.text: Ooh, sounds mysterious! Chippy's so curious!
say:8:1310235007:0.source_cn: 这么神秘？满满已经开始好奇了！
